resources.string: Changes apply immediately to standalone Termux and every Termux workspace. The working directory and tool approvals belong to each workspace.
Default starting directory for this workspace. The assistant can select a subdirectory in chat; the standalone Termux working-directory setting does not change it.
Open Termux setup, check access, or test the connection.
Shared by all assistants and tools, including workspaces. Maximum duration of one turn: 1–60 minutes.
Shared by all assistants and tools, including workspaces. Maximum tool-call iterations in one turn: 1–500.
Default wait for captured commands and foreground workspace console commands: 5–600 seconds. Durable background jobs have their own lifetime.
UTF-8 output preview for captured commands and the workspace console: 1,000–64,000 bytes. More output remains available in command output or job logs.
UTF-8 error preview for captured commands and the workspace console: 500–16,000 bytes. More output remains available in command output or job logs.
Avoid package-manager prompts in captured shell commands and workspace console commands. Interactive terminal sessions keep their normal behavior.
